scenarios.title: Verify Search Results are Not Affected by Category Filters

steps.action:
Preconditions:

expected: Preconditions are met

Test Setup & Data:
Search term: 'Shoes'; Category: 'Women'
expected: Required test setup and data are ready for use.

expected: Only products categorized under 'Women' are displayed.

scenarios.title: Validate Search Results Pagination or Infinite Scroll Behavior

steps.action:
Preconditions:
1. Required setup is available
expected: Preconditions are met

steps.action:
Test Setup & Data:
Search term: 'Book'
expected: Required test setup and data are ready for use.

steps.action: Enter 'Book' into the search input and submit the search.
expected: The 'SEARCHED PRODUCTS' section displays the first set of results (e.g., 10 books). Pagination controls (e.g., 'Next' button, page numbers) or a loading indicator for infinite scroll are visible if more results exist.

steps.action:
If pagination is used: Click the 'Next' page button.
If infinite scroll is used: Scroll down to the bottom of the results.
expected:
If pagination: The next set of search results is displayed, replacing the previous set.
If infinite scroll: The next set of search results is dynamically loaded and appended to the existing list.

scenarios.title: Validate Concurrent Searches Do Not Conflict

steps.action:
Preconditions:
1. Required setup is available
expected: Preconditions are met

steps.action:
Test Setup & Data:
Search 1: 'Laptop'; Search 2: 'Phone'
expected: Required test setup and data are ready for use.

steps.action: Quickly enter 'Laptop' in the search field and submit, then immediately enter 'Phone' and submit again before the first search completes.
expected: The system processes both searches. The final displayed 'SEARCHED PRODUCTS' section accurately reflects the results for 'Phone', which was the most recent search, without showing any residual 'Laptop' results.
